name: Triagain
source:
"Was she... looking at the stars?" 

The summer rain came down in the night park. 
A girl without an umbrella stared up into the sky. 

Her hair and clothes were soaked. She didn't seem to care. 
Mercury lamps that lit the park glittered from the patter of rain. 
She had nowhere to go. 

This strange meeting was the beginning of a life of two. 
They began living together, in a place where they could feel they belonged. 
It was a special time that had no substitute. 

These precious days were fleeting. 
Slowly but surely, time moved forward. 

The frail and gentle story of him and the girl.

translation:
“她……在看星星吗？”

夏雨落在夜晚的公园里。一个没有伞的女孩仰望着天空。她的头发和衣服都湿透了。她似乎并不在意。照亮公园的水银灯在雨滴中闪烁着光芒。她无处可去。

这次奇妙的相遇是两人共同生活的开始。他们开始在一个能感受到归属感的地方同居。那是一段无可替代的特别时光。这些珍贵的日子转瞬即逝。时间缓慢而坚定地向前推进。他与女孩之间脆弱而温柔的故事。
